list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Hexameric neodymium chlorido cluster with lithium chloride and THF

material_class.structural_family: Cp*Nd chlorido hexamer; trigonal-prismatic Nd6 core with a central μ6-Cl and Li–THF-bridged chloride groups

source_locations.location: CCDC deposition statement; catalog refcode YIMGIL

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A hexamer of six Nd atoms bridged by 14 chloride ions, with an additional central chloride; three groups of chloride ions are bridged by Li–THF moieties. The Nd atoms form a trigonal prism around the central chloride.

synthesis.procedure: In a glovebox, Cp*2NdCl·LiCl·2THF (35 mg, 0.056 mmol) and HBcat (80 mg, 0.67 mmol) were combined in a Schlenk tube. After 24 h at room temperature, blue crystals were isolated and characterized by single-crystal X-ray diffraction.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk tube; charged in a glovebox
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Blue crystalline precipitate isolated; characterized by single-crystal X-ray diffraction.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Tetrameric neodymium chlorido cluster with lithium–dioxygen counterions

material_class.structural_family: Anionic Cp*Nd4Cl9 tetramer with a central μ4-Cl; lithium–dioxygen counterions

source_locations.location: CCDC deposition statement; catalog refcode YIMGUX

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The crystallographic unit contains tetrameric anionic Nd4 cluster units. Each has four Cp*Nd units bridged by eight μ2-Cl ions and a central μ4-Cl. Lithium–dioxygen-containing counterion fragments and benzene solvent are also present; the counterion arrangement is disordered.

synthesis.procedure: In a glovebox, Cp*NdCl·LiCl·2THF (35 mg, 0.056 mmol), HBcat (80 mg, 0.67 mmol), and toluene (1 mL) were placed in a Schlenk tube and heated at 110 °C for a few days. The white precipitate was filtered off, the solvent removed under vacuum, and benzene introduced by vacuum transfer. Standing at high temperature for 24 h afforded pale blue crystals.
synthesis.time: a few days; then 24 h after benzene transfer
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk tube; charged in a glovebox; benzene introduced by vacuum transfer
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: White precipitate removed by filtration; solvent removed under vacuum; benzene added by vacuum transfer; pale blue crystals isolated and characterized by single-crystal X-ray diffraction.

material_class.structural_family: Two Cp*Nd3Cl5(THF) units linked by two μ2-Cl bridges

source_locations.location: CCDC deposition statement; catalog refcode YIMHAE

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A hexameric cluster assembled from two symmetric Cp*Nd3Cl5(THF) units joined by two μ2-Cl bridges. The cluster has a chairlike arrangement of six Nd centers; one Nd in each three-metal unit coordinates THF.

synthesis.procedure: In a glovebox, Cp*NdCl·LiCl·2THF (35 mg, 0.056 mmol) and HBpin (80 mg, 0.62 mmol) were combined in a Schlenk tube. After 72 h at room temperature, blue crystals were isolated and characterized by single-crystal X-ray diffraction.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk tube; charged in a glovebox
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Blue crystalline precipitate isolated; characterized by single-crystal X-ray diffraction.

material_class.structural_family: Two Cp*Sm3Cl5(THF) units linked by two μ2-Cl bridges

source_locations.location: CCDC deposition statement; catalog refcode YIMGOR

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Isostructural with 5a: a hexamer assembled from two Cp*Sm3Cl5(THF) units linked by two μ2-Cl bridges, with a chairlike arrangement of six Sm centers.

synthesis.procedure: In a glovebox, Cp*2SmCl·MgCl2·2THF (35 mg, 0.054 mmol) and HBpin (80 mg, 0.62 mmol) were combined in a Schlenk tube. After 72 h, colorless crystals were isolated and characterized by single-crystal X-ray diffraction.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk tube; charged in a glovebox
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Colorless crystalline precipitate isolated; characterized by single-crystal X-ray diffraction.
